## LmdbEnvSub class

Typed sub-collection handle — returned by [LmdbEnv.register()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.register.md) and bound to a schema class.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class LmdbEnvSub<S extends typeof LmdbSchema> 
```

## Remarks

The handle is self-contained: it holds its own  (sub-DB handle + codec + embedded-index descriptors) so every operation runs directly on the sub-DB without a per-call schema lookup on the env. One schema class = one state = one handle (the env caches handles), so `env.register(UserSchema) === env.sub(UserSchema)`<!-- -->.

Cross-collection work goes through [LmdbEnvSub.owner](./lmdb.lmdbenvsub.owner.md) — the owning env — for transactions (`sub.owner.transaction(...)`<!-- -->) and access to other registered subs (`sub.owner.sub(OtherSchema)`<!-- -->).
